description: This file defines the EmployeeDependentDao class, which manages database operations related to employee dependents in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee dependents, utilizing a database query builder and integrating with the ORM layer.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for EmployeeDependent entities, providing methods to interact with employee dependents in the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Retrieves all dependents for a given employee number, ordered ascending by name.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dependent by employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingDependentIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing dependent sequence IDs for a given employee and list of IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Saves an employee dependent, assigning a sequence number if not set, with validation.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Deletes dependents for an employee based on provided sequence IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Searches dependents based on specified filter parameters using pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for dependents based on search filters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of dependents matching search filters.
